mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( IMG_KEY VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, REQ_DATE DATETIME, IMG_STATUS VARCHAR(10), CHANNEL VARCHAR(10), FILE_ID VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, FILE_URL VARCHAR(200), METADATA_HASH_CODE VARCHAR(11), WIDE_YN VARCHAR(1), IMG_PATH VARCHAR(200), IMG_URL VARCHAR(200), REG_DATE DATETIME, EXP_DATE DATETIME, DONE_CODE VARCHAR(10), DONE_CODE_DESC VARCHAR(200), DONE_DATE DATETIME, CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY (IMG_KEY) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( IMG_KEY, REQ_DATE, IMG_STATUS, CHANNEL, FILE_ID, METADATA_HASH_CODE, WIDE_YN, IMG_PATH, IMG_URL ) VALUES ( #{parameter.key}, NOW(), #{parameter.imageStatus}, #{parameter.channel}, #{parameter.fileId}, #{parameter.metadataHashCode}, #{parameter.wideYn}, #{parameter.imagePath}, #{parameter.imageUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT /* +RULE*/ IMG_KEY AS `key`, CHANNEL, FILE_ID, METADATA_HASH_CODE AS metadata_hash_code, WIDE_YN, IMG_PATH AS image_path, IMG_URL AS image_url FROM ${tableName} WHERE IMG_STATUS = 'ready' AND REQ_DATE < NOW() LIMIT 100
SELECT IMG_KEY AS `key` FROM ${tableName} WHERE IMG_STATUS = 'request' AND REQ_DATE < NOW() - 30 / 24 / 60 / 60 LIMIT 100
SELECT IMG_KEY AS `key`, METADATA_HASH_CODE FROM ${tableName} WHERE IMG_STATUS = 'complete' AND EXP_DATE < NOW() LIMIT 100

SELECT IMG_KEY AS `key`, IMG_STATUS AS image_status, FILE_ID, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS expire_date, DONE_CODE FROM ${tableName} WHERE METADATA_HASH_CODE = #{metadataHashCode} ORDER BY EXP_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
